title: 18_100754_general_1946-7_vol_2
doc_notes: This document is a collection of internal Air Materiel Command and Air Force correspondence regarding the investigation and policy toward 'Flying Discs' and contains reports of specific claims.

encounters.summary: A report of flying discs sighted by a radar station in Japan, mentioned by Dr. Charles Carroll.
Mrs. Madeline Gwynne Merchant claims flying discs are being fired from a laboratory in Central Mexico operated by Russians to target U.S. atomic and aircraft installations.
encounters.quote: Flying Discs are being fired from a locality in Central Mexico from a laboratory which is being operated by the Russians.
